summary:

2. add copper sulfate (Ⅱ) to water

4. take out the manure paper and put it in the funnel
5. place the funnel in the stand and place the empty beaker underneath
6. add the water mixed with copper sulfate (Ⅱ) and iron powder to the funnel.
Observe the material left on the manure paper
